categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies descriptor interfaces in src/script/descriptor.{cpp,h} by exposing PubkeyProvider and ParsePubkey to support wallet key inspection and validation.
categories.rationale: Exposes key expression parsing and origin inspection needed by wallet setup wizards (tracking in #35645) and fixes an edge-case parser bug accepting trailing characters after musig() expressions. This provides clear utility for wallet descriptor configuration without posing an urgent correctness or fund safety risk.
